THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
AFTERLIGHT
018
20 / Leopard Fur
Extreme close-up beauty portrait with long black
windswept hair, dense freckles across the nose and cheeks,
brown eyes, muted rose lips and a plush leopard-print faux-fur
collar against a pale, near-white background.
21 / Midnight Mist
Very long, wavy black hair, a pale blue-gray sleeveless
gown with a corset bodice and delicate lace trim, a silver bracelet
and a deep teal misty backdrop. She looks over her shoulder with
a dramatic, romantic expression.
